items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds to confirm family relationships ('sister-in-law') and does not describe any personal or professional interaction with Mike Lyman.

ctx.x: Well, no. We broadcast, I believe, on
a Monday night, I think. I think it was (inaudible), because we were out there, I think, six weeks and we left there and went to Mike Lyman's, downtown at the Club Alabama, on Spring.
Is that where the Club Alabama was then?
